sources.title: Architecture graph for UncannyEcho/Aura-Large-v1-BF16.
sources.snippet: UncannyEcho/Aura-Large-v1-BF16 is a model (gemma4_text architecture). It uses 60 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,376, and 32 query heads with 16 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).

sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face. Qwythos-9B-v2, Qwythos-27B-v1, and Abacus — open weights, open code, open datasets.
